turns.text: How to move the client from chatting to meeting face-to-face if he's in Dubai or at least a Zoom call. The main mistake that you as an agent doing is actually telling him that you need a meeting or he need a meeting. Instead of that, you have to ask him a question. Would that make sense for you to book a little bit more time together on a Zoom where you can see with your own eyes the actual transaction data from Dubai Land Department for the past three years, just to understand if investment in Dubai or investment in this area or this type of unit will be a right decision for you. Would that make sense for us to book that meeting? You see, us, you, not me.
